nom: Avène Cicalfate+ Hydrating Skin Recovery Emulsion

avis.texte: This is unfortunately not the same PERFECT emulsion they once made. The texture, smell and finish are way off and some of the best ingredients are missing. Why fix whats not broken? It was once my fave moisturizer and im SO SAD.

Immediately from opening, my cream comes out in some kind of watery solution which makes application difficult if you're doing anything but dumping out the watery solution. Was excited to try this but the quality doesn't match the price.

I also purchased this product online, but they sent me one that had already been opened, used, and oxidized. This is unacceptable and intolerable. When a product is paid for, they will be happy, but we receive trash. Not happy at all with Ulta.
I used this not even for 3 days and i woke up this morning with my skin swollen and red. My skin has been itchy all day and now i have red patches all over my face.
I wanted to use it as a face cream but I find it dries out a bit much for my taste

I purchased this really not knowing much about its benefits other than those stated in the description. I don't do any kind of dermatological procedures on my skin, staying as natural as possible and embracing the crinkles. I opted to try this as an all over treatment at night and also to add a small amount in with my daily moisturizer. I find it amazing for my combination skin. It seems to make everything so soft, smooth and balanced. And if I have dry patches or a problem area that won't heal, this is a game changer. I've had less breakouts as well. I gifted a tube to my 33yr old daughter and she absolutely loves it for her sensitive, hormonal skin. She uses it in more targeted areas and is amazed at her results. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Soothing, calming and healing to irritated skin
avis.texte: My dermatologist had me use Efudex (chemo cream) on my chest for 14 days. If anyone has ever used Efudex, you know that any cancerous cells become very aggravated and painful. When I finished the 14 day treatment my chest was basically raw. I used this cream after the treatment was completed and I can't even tell you how soothing it was, it really did help with healing. I would recommend this to anyone that has to undergo that type of treatment of course verifying it with your doctor, my doctor recommends it. I was a sun junking living in Florida.

I rarely write reviews but this issue was important to me. Just received the Cicalfate+ Hydrating Skin Recovery Emulsion that I was so anxious to try. I've used so many of Avene products over the last several years. Although the Emulsion is pleasant to use and soothes my very red irritated complexion, my reason for the low score is the product arrived in a crumpled box and there WAS NO FOIL SEAL inside the lid. All the other products were fine and the outside shipping box was not damaged. Obviously someone had already dove into this product. VERY DISAPPOINTED. I expected better quality control.

I bought this because I thought it would be like a lighter version of the thick cicalfate that is amazing. It was definitely lighter in viscosity and was thick but it actually stung my skin when I was having extreme sensitivity due to using a high prescription tretinoin. I've never experienced this reaction with the original cicalfate. I'll keep the product but won't use it on my face. I knocked off three stars due to cost, the slimy thick texture and the fact didn't calm my reactive skin.

avis.titre: i really didn't want to love this. and yet
avis.texte: pros of avene's cicalfate line: really, REALLY good for people with skin barrier issues, the only thing that immediately calms my redness, feels kind of cooling, surprisingly lightweight, products pair really well together pros of this specific product: pairs well with the cream, VERY lightweight, works well under makeup, cooling (for me, at least, idk if it's intentional), immediately and dramatically reduces my facial redness (and, importantly, keeps it from coming back!!), no added fragrance but still doesn't smell weird, don't need much at a time, i like the shade of green lol cons of avene's cicalfate line: the difference between the usa price of avene products and the eu price of avene products is the epitome of 'a funny trick to play on god,' except that instead of god it's me, a broke human, and instead of laughing i'm crying in USD tl;dr, i really love it, and the line in general is a really good alternative to the other cica-lines out there if you need something with 0 actives! but also avene WHY ps always patch test! 'sensitive friendly' =/= 'your-skin friendly', etc etc

avis.titre: Why fix something that isn't broken
avis.texte: The discontinued version of this cream- the Cicalfate emulsion- is a miracle product for my skin. This new version is terrible and something I cannot use. Shea butter, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid etc are simply unnecessary ingredients and unfortunately they cause major irritation to my skin. Overall I'm just so disappointed that is seems like Avène would rather use trendy ingredients than stick to a formula that actually works. I truly hope they just bring back the original.
